annotations.title: Card fee paid by the client

description: Whether this set of books passes the card PROCESSING fee of a client's card payment on to the client (invoice pay link, Tap to Pay, and card-on-file charges the client agreed to). Only the processing fee (processingBps / 100 % plus processingFixedMinor cents), never a Mobile Accounting fee; only credit cards (never debit, prepaid or Interac); at most capPercent of the amount (the business pays anything above). available=false with reasonCode COUNTRY or REGION means it is not allowed where the business is (outside the US and Canada, or in Quebec, Connecticut, Massachusetts or Puerto Rico); reasonCode OFF means allowed but not turned on. This only reads: the business owner turns it on or off in Mobile Accounting (settingsUrl), where they confirm the card rules themselves.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books (optional when the connection reaches only one).
